facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 5 to 19 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: White Pass E.S.
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 26 (2023), May 28 (2024), May 26 (2025)

evidence.name: Pigtail Peak
evidence.detail: left June 9; earlier seasons: June 13 (2023), June 28 (2024), June 14 (2025)

evidence.name: Green Lake
evidence.detail: left May 9; earlier seasons: May 24 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 22 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: White Pass E.S.
evidence.detail: 15.6 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 26.5 in (2023), 22.7 in (2024), 26.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Pigtail Peak
evidence.detail: 38.9 in on April 6; earlier seasons: 44.3 in (2023), 44.1 in (2024), 53.6 in (2025)

evidence.name: Green Lake
evidence.detail: 17.7 in on April 5; earlier seasons: 30.3 in (2023), 21.8 in (2024), 28.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 15 and May 29, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: White Pass E.S.
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, at the pass elevation; points to April 16 to May 29

evidence.name: Pigtail Peak
evidence.detail: melted out June 9, 1,331 ft above the pass; points to April 15 to June 17

evidence.name: Green Lake
evidence.detail: melted out May 9, 1,451 ft above the pass; points to March 12 to May 16
